source_event_filter: PM2.5 observed and at least 12/13 real current channels observed, never future-target selection
supervision: source-measured next clock hour, 13 valid physical channels and observed 13-channel availability
source_action_field_semantics: observation availability and known recorded hour clock only, no interventions
history_feed: For each of 12 named source stations use the first 768 source-eligible chronological training observations, one persistent stream per station, 24 consecutive 32-event truncated-backprop blocks; never reset state between blocks within a seed
full_nn_comparator_FLOP_parity: NOT ESTABLISHED; single learned model only
development_evaluation: One 12-station continuous fresh-state stream per seed, source-observed May 1-June 10 2014; score true next-hour results by persistent event index bands 32-63,64-127,128-255,256-511,512+, all other source inputs known at prediction time
checkpoint_requirements: Original per seed learned weights+AdamW+PyTorch/Python RNG, train source ordinal time index SHA, optimizer trace committed before DEV scores; frozen read-only fresh-checkout replay all five saved predictions
